title: Build Git Hub history operations
responsibility: Provide branch, ancestry, commit, changed-path and optional-ref queries over a source adapter.

inputs.name: ensureAncestry.client
inputs.description: Transport used to compare the requested commit with the branch tip.

inputs.name: ensureAncestry.commit
inputs.description: Commit that must equal the tip or be its ancestor.

inputs.name: githubHistory.adapter
inputs.description: Source adapter for resolving refs and reading immutable trees.

inputs.name: githubHistory.options
inputs.description: Scoped token callback and optional fetch implementation.

outputs.name: ensureAncestry
outputs.description: Resolves without a value when the commits match or GitHub confirms the requested ancestor.

outputs.name: githubHistory
outputs.description: History methods that list branches and commits, compare each commit to its first parent, resolve optional refs, read facts and test reachability.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects unreachable anchors, invalid input or source data, unavailable GitHub and histories exceeding 100 pages of 100 records.
